rows.abstract: States that local government units shall have a [forty] FIFTY percent share in the gross collection of the antional government from its share in any co=production or joint venture in the development of the national wealth within their territorial jurisdiction. Provides futher that eighty percent (80%) of the proceeds from the development of hydro, geothermal and other sources of energy be applied solely to lower the cost of electricity in the ENTIRE PROVINE OF RESIDENTIAL CONSUMERS where such source of energy is located.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1996-03-18

rows.author: B016
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING CITY AND MUNICIPAL MAYORS TO ORGANIZE LOCAL POLICE AUXILIARY UNITS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Is based on the observation that the most glaring cause for the poor state of our police system is the inadequate number of policemen, particularly those assigned in the field. Provides, therefore, that the members of the local police auxiliary units shall enforce TRAFFIC laws and perform ADMINISTRATIVE duties. Provides, further that the members of these units shall NOT be issued or authorized to carry FIREARMS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1996-03-18
